title: Editor: First load_resource_pack() recursively indexes the entire project and can stall for seconds
body:
### Tested versions

- Godot 4.7.1 .NET
- Windows 11 (`10.0.26200`)

### Issue description

The first call to `ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack()` while running a project from the editor can stall for several seconds. The time appears to scale with the number of files in the source project, rather than primarily with the size or entry count of the PCK being mounted.

In a real project I measured:

| Case | Time |
| --- | ---: |
| Editor run, no PCK to mount | 0.3 ms |
| Editor run, first `load_resource_pack()` | 7378.4 ms |
| Exported build loading the same PCK | No comparable stall |

Project/PCK characteristics:

- Project directory: 47,203 files
- `.godot`: about 12,771 files
- `.git`: about 6,945 files
- PCK: 80.9 MiB, about 750 entries

The directory also contains tests, source code and generated/platform directories which are not runtime resources. Directories marked with `.gdignore` and hidden directories are still visited by this path.

This makes dynamic resource packs look very slow during editor testing even when the pack itself is small in terms of entry count. The exported build behaves normally because it already uses a main pack.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a Godot project with a large number of files. Files under `.git`, or under a directory containing `.gdignore`, are sufficient to make the difference visible.
2. Create a small valid PCK outside the project or in a subdirectory.
3. Measure the first call while running from the editor:

```gdscript
func _ready() -> void:
    var started := Time.get_ticks_usec()
    var loaded := ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack("path/to/test.pck", true)
    var elapsed_ms := (Time.get_ticks_usec() - started) / 1000.0
    print("loaded=", loaded, ", elapsed=", elapsed_ms, " ms")
```

4. Increase or decrease the number of unrelated files in the project directory and run again.
5. Compare with an exported build loading the same PCK.

### Suspected cause

This appears to be a side effect of the fix for #19815, introduced by commit d17ce4c37efccd6c1be89a66ff4dc14c60ff0111.

On the first dynamic pack load when the project is still backed by a loose `res://` directory, `ProjectSettings::_load_resource_pack()` registers a `PackedSourceDirectory` and calls `add_pack("res://", ...)` so that the original project files remain visible after mounting the new pack.

`PackedSourceDirectory::add_directory()` then:

- enables hidden entries with `set_include_hidden(true)`;
- adds every file;
- recursively visits every directory;
- does not consult `.gdignore` or any other exclusion rule.

Relevant implementation:

- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/core/config/project_settings.cpp
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/core/io/file_access_pack.cpp
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/d17ce4c37efccd6c1be89a66ff4dc14c60ff0111

### Expected behavior

The first dynamic PCK load from an editor run should not eagerly enumerate tens of thousands of unrelated project files.

Possible directions could include:

- keeping the loose filesystem as a lazy fallback/overlay instead of copying its complete directory tree into `PackedData`;
- adding a safe exclusion mechanism for `PackedSourceDirectory`;
- excluding VCS metadata such as `.git`;
- clarifying whether `.gdignore` should affect this path.

Blindly excluding all of `.godot` may not be correct because imported resources and UID data can be required while running from the editor. The main concern is the unconditional eager recursion over the complete project directory.
